mapper.select: SELECT id, work_id, title, content, order_num, created_at, updated_at FROM work_mindmaps WHERE work_id = #{workId} ORDER BY order_num ASC, created_at ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO work_mindmaps (work_id, title, content, order_num, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{workId}, #{title}, #{content}, #{orderNum}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
mapper.update: UPDATE work_mindmaps SET title = #{title}, content = #{content}, order_num = #{orderNum}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
